name: Yuutenji Mishio
source:
Metis: <Prominence> (Fire)

[url=/c31817]Keiji[/url]'s kouhai. She is the leader of Argonauts and the daughter of Yuutenji family, the founder of Suminoe Gakuen. She leads a trustful relationship with her attendants, [url=/c31819]Tomo[/url] and [url=/c31818]Nao[/url]. Because of her positions, she puts on facade of a haughty ojousama, which both [url=/c31817]Keiji[/url] and [url=/c12468]Manami[/url] immediately see through. She is actually a docile girl, and has a hard time making friend. She seems to know Keiji in the past...
